text:
Predicates:
British(x) ::: x is British.
Sitcom(x) ::: x is a sitcom series.
Starring(x, y) ::: x stars members of y.
Pilot(x, y) ::: x was piloted in y.
WorkingTitle(x, y) ::: y was used for x.
ScriptEditor(x, y) ::: x was the script editor for y.
Pappy(x) ::: x is a member of Pappy's.
BBCThree() ::: BBC Three.
BBCTwo() ::: BBC Two.
July2013() ::: July 2013.
TheSecretDudeSociety() ::: The Secret Dude Society.
AndrewCollins() ::: Andrew Collins.
Badults() ::: Badults.
Premises:
Sitcom(Badults) ∧ British(Badults) ∧ Starring(Badults, Pappy) ::: Badults is a British Sitcom series starring members of Pappy's.
Pilot(Badults, July2013) ∧ Pilot(Badults, BBCThree) ::: Badults was piloted in July 2013 on BBC Three.
WorkingTitle(TheSecretDudeSociety, Badults) ::: The working title 'The Secret Dude Society' was used for Badults.
ScriptEditor(AndrewCollins, Badults) ::: Andrew Collins was the script editor for Badults.
Conclusion:
¬∃x (Starring(x, Pappy) ∧ (Pilot(x, BBCTwo) ∨ Pilot(x, BBCThree))) ::: No members of Pappy's have starred in a show piloting on BBC Two or BBC Three.
